Welcome to

Roast &Roots

Coffee grown with care, served with warmth

Who We Are

Roast&Roots is a neighborhood coffee house built around slow roasts and real ingredients. We source small-lot beans, roast them in small batches, and pour them in a room made for long conversations. Every cup starts with the same promise: honest coffee, warm service, and a place that feels like home.

Our Services

Come in for a careful pour, a quiet table, or a gathering. We host tasting flights, weekend acoustic nights, and private bookings for birthdays and meetings. Guests on our list get reserved parking while they stay.

Menu

The board is built for mornings and slow afternoons. Start with a bright House Americano, move into a Roots Cappuccino, or take a dark roast that holds its flavor to the last sip.
